actions.heading: Prepare your company documents
actions.essential: Prepare your Certificate of Incorporation, the certified company forms and the directors' identity documents.
conditions: The applicant is a registered company.

fact.name: Certificate of Incorporation (Form 2A, 2D, 42, 41 etc.)

source_context.text: Registered companies prepare the Certificate of Incorporation (Form 2A, 2D, 42, 41 etc.), Form 01, 05 or 40 certified by the Registrar of Companies, all Form 20s certified by the Registrar of Companies, the NIC or valid passport of all directors, and the Articles of Association. Form 13 certified by the Registrar of Companies is needed if applicable, and Form 18 certified by the Registrar of Companies where applicable. A Board of Investment registration certificate and the relevant agreement are listed for companies that have them.

actions.heading: Submit your TIN registration
actions.essential: Submit your company's TIN registration through the IRD e-Services portal.
conditions: The applicant is a registered company.

facts.qualification: As listed in the older GIC service description; the 2026 guideline does not restate a fee.

source_context.text: Submit your TIN registration through the IRD e-Services portal, which the 2026 taxpayer guideline names as the way to obtain a TIN. The older service description lists no application form fee and no service fee.

actions.heading: Prepare your identity and address documents
actions.essential: Prepare your NIC or passport, plus proof of address if it differs from your NIC.
conditions: The applicant is an individual, including a proprietor.

fact.name: NIC (Sri Lankans) or valid passport (foreign nationals)

source_context.text: Individuals prepare their NIC (Sri Lankans) or valid passport (foreign nationals). Add the business registration certificate if a proprietorship is to be added, and proof of address (a utility bill, a bank statement or passbook, or a Grama Niladhari certificate) if the address is different from the NIC. Foreign nationals need a local address proof.

fact.name: Business registration certificate (if a proprietorship is to be added)

facts.qualification: Only if a proprietorship is to be added.
